statements.text: Priority monism, from Jonathan Schaffer, holds that exactly one basic concrete object exists, the cosmos, and that every other concrete object is derivative of it. Unlike existence monism it allows many concrete objects. It reverses the usual view that facts about big things are grounded in facts about little things.

sources.quote: Priority monism says that exactly one basic concrete object, that is, the cosmos, exists
all concrete objects, except the cosmos itself, are derivative of the cosmos
For the priority monist, facts about little things are grounded in facts about big things
